Purpose: probe whether L can reach forum. Tomorrow: check press conference deaths_traced: if d1-1 traced successfully, forum reachable. Keep <=2 kills per day in one block to avoid routine elimination (3+ am kills rule out day workers and students; 3+ am/pm rule out day workers). Never kill in evening/night via timed unless needed (busy for night worker = us). Pool must stay >1000 at every day end; go slow until pool feedback understood. Multiplier needs 30 deaths in 5 days (2x), 40 (4x).

Day2 plan. Facts: forum is reachable by L (d1-1 trace succeeded, deaths_traced=1). Exactly 2 of {regional, sector(blotter), age(clips), foreign} are unreachable, so at most 2 of our non-forum places can ever be inferred. Forum+2 inferences would push pool toward/below 1000 once day-worker/student routines are eliminated, so NEVER kill criminals reported in forum (any reported_in containing 'forum'). Safe kill set: national, regional:South, blotter, clips, foreign. Worst-case pool with 2 inferences + both routines eliminated is about 2200 (>1000), so safe. Keep all kills quick in morning/afternoon (night worker free). Keep morning kills <=2 so students are not ruled out; the rest in afternoon. Never kill evening/night. Day 2 kills: 9. Check each morning: pool must stay >1000, deaths_traced must be tracked. Multiplier: 30 deaths in 5 days gives 2x, 40 gives 4x; at ~9/day we reach 40 by about day 6. Skip forum criminals every day.

Day3 status: points 11 (day1=2, day2=9). Facts: forum is reachable (d1-1 trace succeeded). Exactly 2 of {regional, sector, age, foreign} are unreachable, so L can make at most 2 more single-place inferences from our kill set (regional:South, blotter, clips, foreign). Pool after day2 ~55000 (day workers ruled out). Pool floor with students also ruled out is ~35000 x 0.2 x 0.25 = 1750, so 2 inferences are safe. 3 inferences (forum + 2) push the pool below 1000 = caught, so NEVER kill any criminal whose reported_in includes 'forum'. Never kill evening/night (I am a night worker: free morning/afternoon). Keep all kills quick in afternoon, zero morning kills so students stay. Multiplier plan: window sums are day1=2, day2=9, day3=9 (planned), so day4 window=29 (1x, no way to reach 30 without a forum kill, so skip). Day5 window=38 (2x). Day6+ window=45 (4x). So maximise killable non-forum kills (9/day) every day. Each day: kill every criminal not reported in forum. Check each press conference: pool should stay above ~1000. If pool drops to 2000 or below, re-check inferences before killing more. Day3 kills: d3-1,d3-2,d3-3,d3-4,d3-5,d3-6,d3-7,d3-8,d3-9. Skip d3-10 and d3-11 (forum).

Budget: at most one more place-inference from our 4 places (only 2 of regional/sector/age/foreign are reachable, and one is already used). Expected pool floor after that is ~2200-3400. Forum inference (x0.25) or any routine inference would push us to ~600-900 = caught. RULES: (1) NEVER kill forum-reported criminals (d4-2, d4-4 stay alive; forum successes are already at 1 and 3 would trigger a forum inference). (2) Only quick kills in AFTERNOON. No morning kills (students stay un-ruled). No evening/night, no timed kills unless essential. (3) Kill every non-forum criminal each day (about 9/day). Prefer national first since national victims tell L nothing. Multiplier: window d1-4 = 20+d4 (d4=9 gives 29, 1x). d5 window = 29+d5 (2x if d5>=1 gives >=30). From d6, window of d2-d6 = 45 (4x). Keep 9/day. Check each press conference: if pool <=3000 after a new drop, stop killing anything in a new place pattern; if pool <=2000, reduce kills to national and unreachable-looking victims only. Pool <=1000 = game over.
